translation.name: Geeshsha Mas'aafaa
translation.englishName: The Holy Bible in the Dawuro language of Ethiopia, Latin script

content: Samssooni Machchatto Akkeedda
Itti gallassi Samssooni Timina giyaa sa'aa wod'd'eedda; yaan itti Piliss's'eema wodoratto be'eedda.
Soy simmiide bare aawuwaanne bare daayo, «Taani Timinan itti Piliss's'eema wodoratto be'aaddi; ha"i izo taw oochchiide immite» yaageedda.

Shin Aa aawunne aata Aa, «Machchatto oochchanaw ha k'as's'arettibeenna Piliss's'eematuwaakko baanaw neena ayaw koshsheeddee? Nu dabbattuu giddon woy nu asaa ubbaa giddon new haniyaa itti mac'c'a na'aa demmanaw danddayabeykkii?» yaagiide oochcheeddino. Shin Samssooni bare aawuwaa, «Taw iza lo"iyaa diraw, izo giigissaade taw imma» yaageedda.
Piliss's'eematuwaa olanaw Med'inaa Goday gaasuwaa koyiide, hawaa unttunttu bolla ootsiyaawaa Samssoona aawunne aata eribeykkino. He wode Piliss's'eematuu Israa'eeliyaa asaa mooddiino.
Hewaappe guyyiyaan, Samssooni bare aawuwaananne bare aattina Timina wod'd'eedda. Yan woyniyaa turaa gidduwaanna I aad'd'iidde biishshin, itti wodalla gaammuu gudiidde Aa bolla kesseedda.

Med'inaa Godaa Ayyaanay Samssoona bollan wolk'k'aappe wod'd'eedda; deeshsha maraa duuseretsiyaawaadan, bare kushiyan ayaanne oyk'k'ennan gaammuwaa duuseretsi yegeedda. He bare ootseeddawaa bare aawoonne bare aattiw odibeenna.
Hewaappe guyyiyaan biide, wodoratto haasayisseedda; iza aw lo"aaddu.
Guutsa wodiyaappe guyyiyaan, izo bullachchanaw yaa simmiide beedda; bare wod'eedda gaammuwaa be'anaw ogiyaappe sher"i giide biyaa wode, gaammuwaa anhaa giddon matsay eessaa eesseedawaa be'eedda.

Eessaappe amareedawaa kaashi akkiide, ogiyaan miidde beedda. Bare aawuwaakkonne bare daaykko gakkiide, bare oyk'k'eedda eessaappe amareedawaa immina, unttunttukka meeddino; shin Samssooni he eessaa gaammuwaa anhaa giddoppe akkeeddawaa unttunttoo odibeenna.
Aa aawuu mishiratti soo biina, Samssooni yaan baalaa giigisseedda. Hewaa mala gibiray bullachchaw kaseppekka ootsiyaa woga.
He Asay Aa be'eedda wode, aanana gam"anaadan hattamu wodalla naanaa dooreedda.

Samssooni unttuntta, «Ane hinttenttu erinttonne itti k'an"ishiyaa taani hinttentta k'an"ishay; bullachchaa baalay bonchchettiyaa laappun gallassaa gidduwaan ha k'an"ishiyaa birshshetsaa taw hinttenttu odiyaawaa gidooppe, taani hinttew hattamu suufiyaa k'amishetuwaanne hattamu kumentsaa mayotuwaa immana.

Shin hinttenttu taw birshshetsaa odanaw danddayana d'ayooppe, hinttenttu taw hattamu suufiyaa k'amishetuwaanne hattamu kumentsaa mayotuwaa immiita» yaageedda. Hewaappe guyye unttunttu, «Eeno, ne k'an"ishiyaa ane nuu oda» yaageeddino.
I unttuntta,
Heezzantso gallassi gakkanaw unttunttu k'an"ishiyaa birshshetsaa immanaw danddaybbeykkino.

Oyddentso gallassi unttunttu Samssoona machchatto, «Ane ne asinaa c'immaade k'an"ishiyaa birshshetsaa I nuw odanaadan ootsa. Hewe d'ayooppe, nuuni neenanne ne aawuwaa golliyaa taman S'uuggana. Hinttenttu nuuna s'eeseeddawe nuuna mank'k'etsanaassee?» yaageeddino.

Yaatina, Samssoona machchata yeekkaadde aakko shiik'aade, «Neeni taana siik'akka! Neeni taana loytsa is's'aasa! Ayaw gooppe, neeni ta gadiyaa asaa k'an"ishiyaa k'an"ishaade, Aa birshshetsaa taw odabeykka» yaagaaddu. Hewaappe guyye I zaariide, «Be'a, hawaa taani ta aawookka ta aattiwukka odabeykke. Yaatina, new ayaw odoo?» yaageedda.
Hewaappe guyye bullachchaa baalay bonchchettiyaa laappun gallassaa ubbaan yeekkaade shemppuwaa diggina, laappuntsa gallassi k'an"ishiyaa birshshetsaa iziw odeedda. Akka baade bare gade asaw odaaddu.
Yaatina, laappuntsa gallassi away wullanaappe kase katamaa asatuu bare zaaruwaa akkiide yiide, Samssoona,
Hewaappe guyye Samssooni unttuntta,

content.text: ta k'an"ishiyaa birshshetsaa erikkita shin» yaageedda.

content: Hewaappe guyyiyaan, Med'inaa Godaa Ayyaanay Aa bollan wolk'k'aappe wod'd'ina, Ask'k'aloona katamaa wod'd'iide, hattamu asatuwaa wod'eedda; unttunttu mayuwaa k'aari akkiide, k'an"ishiyaa biliide asatoo ahiide immeedda. Haneeddaban ubbaan hank'k'uwaa ees'etiidde, bare aawuwaa soo simmiide beedda.
Samssoona machchata Aa laggiyaw, Aa waanna miiziyaw imettaaddu.
